summary: Bertie County, NC: an 80-foot tower erected in 1928 for the state Division of Forest Resources, later removed; no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Only one history page covers this tower (Forest Lookouts, 2 lines of text), so the 1928 build date and removal rest on it alone. Two web searches found nothing else about this tower; the Woodville hits were the Bertie County historic district and the Texas Woodville lookout, which is a different site. The Former Fire Lookout Sites register lists two North Carolina sites and neither is Woodville. No source gives a removal date, a design beyond the 80-foot height, staffing, or the site today. Access is unknown, so no access fact is recorded.
